description:
Angry IP scanner is a very fast IP address and port scanner.


- Windows installer: Italian and Spanish translations and file properties #562
- Windows: default silent install and uninstall to the current user when no install mode is specified #561
- Windows: rebuild launcher to avoid concatenation in the installer, hopefully flagging less virus heuristics #565
- Enable Comments fetcher by default for new users
- Fix loading of results exported from other feeders than IP Range #387
- Open dialogs on the same monitor as the main window, even if it is above or to the left of the primary one #346
- Do not restore the main window outside of the visible area, e.g. after disconnecting an external screen #393
- Show comments stored by MAC address regardless of the order of columns #419
- Windows: pass IPv4 addresses to ICMP and ARP APIs as plain integers, which may fix bogus alive hosts and MAC addresses #337 #395 #488
- Fix reverse IP ranges (start > end) scanning past the end when crossing a byte boundary
- IP List File feeder: detect the network interface for all hosts, not only the first one
- Linux: fix leaking of file descriptors when reading the ARP table
- TCP pinger: fix possible hanging after a very fast reply and keep probing the port that has responded
- UDP pinger: count actual UDP replies as alive
- Hostname fetcher: accept hostnames that resolve to multiple addresses, e.g. both IPv4 and IPv6
- Do not use 100% of a CPU core while waiting for a free thread if thread delay is 0
- Updated translations for all languages
